title: LLV-GBRQ125: two-entry tables at the eighth-source envelope

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the one LLV-GBRQ125 configuration in proof.md recovers the full secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch charged work is O(2^(2sqrt(n)log2(n)+8sqrt(n)(log2(n))^(1/4))), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. Main parameters are v=floor sqrt n,ell=ceil log2n,ell2=ceil log2ell,D=ell+2ell2+9/2,m=floor((v-256ell)/(4D)),kappa=ceil log2(m+2)+3,lambda=1,A_bar=ceil((n+m*kappa)/m)+2,center=ceil(ell*(m-1)/2),fan_i=A_bar+ell*i-center. Exact prefix capacity and final k=R+kappa+1 handle every remainder. Source/leaf caps, every failed request, full all-modulus decoders and finite branch are retained. Sections8,14 prove every-level and finishing work by disjoint same-level leaf charging with internal exponent2sqrt(n)log2(n)+4sqrt(n)log2log2n+O(sqrt n)+O((log n)^2); strict eventual slack absorbs all polynomial cost. Source/LE, lookup/exclusion, generation, addresses, failures, measurement and cleanup count jointly with all other claims.

For this same LLV-GBRQ125 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak classical space is O(n^2) bits with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. There are O(n) retained phase tables, each containing two 3n-bit labels. The single current tuple list uses O(n) bits; current residue/sort/input arrays use O(n^(3/2)log n)<=O(n^2). The stack, cap and parameter arithmetic, source/LE scratch, streamed gate/address generation and decoder records/candidate arithmetic fit O(n^2), as detailed in Section14. No exponential circuit, full tree or truth table is stored. This holds jointly with unconditional full-secret success and all other claims.

For this same LLV-GBRQ125 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak quantum allocation is O(n) qubits with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. Pending siblings use O(sum_i fan_i)=O(n); current finish/search uses O(fan_max)=O(sqrt(n)log n)<=O(n) scratch, reset and reused between trials. Source/LE, rank/projection, failed work and cleanup are included. The exact centered sum gives m*A_bar<=n+m*kappa+3m. This holds jointly with unconditional full-secret success and all other claims.

For this same LLV-GBRQ125 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, total acquired copies number O(2^((1/8)sqrt n)), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. Every failed, discarded, rejected and aborted request counts. Dbar=2K*fan_max*A_bar^m,Dcap=2^12nDbar,Ccap=2^13nDbar. Exact centered AM-GM controls every fan-in prefix and final arity through fan_max*A_bar^m. Section8 proves fan_max<=(19/4)sqrt(n)*ell, 19^4<2^17, and log2A_bar<=log2n/2+log2ell+9/4<=D/2, so m*log2A_bar<=(v-256ell)/8 and all polynomial cap factors fit literal nCcap+K<=2^(v/8). Finite lengths change only outside constants. These bounds hold jointly with unconditional full-secret success and every other claim.

For the same LLV-GBRQ125 algorithm and configuration of proof.md, the proved fractional error tolerance is epsilon(n) = 0: all Q source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N and s, full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1 - 2^-8 jointly with all four resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted; this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
